approvalDecision.boundary: No content approval, provider/model budget, calibration acceptance, release gate or publication permission.

semantics.aggregation: Minimum of every applicable dimension and complete required child, never an average. NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed only for dimensions excluded by the subject's interaction contract.
semantics.PASS: Complete attributable evidence; every required dimension and child >=0.90; no hard fail, missing evidence, low confidence, inclusive 0.87..0.93 score, unresolved child or disagreement. Scores exactly 0.90 require adjudication. Product Owner approved this semantics on 2026-10-23; calibration remains a separate phase.
semantics.FAIL: An evidenced hard fail or a required score below 0.90. Other blockers are retained even when FAIL wins precedence. No promotion of a hard fail is implemented in 09-B.
semantics.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Missing dimensions, required decisions, current item coverage, sources, child evidence, unresolved declared inputs or an explicitly incomplete assessment. Never PASS.
semantics.DISAGREEMENT: Judges differ on hard fails/disposition or any required dimension by more than 0.03. No majority vote or averaging.
semantics.ADJUDICATION_REQUIRED: Inclusive 0.87..0.93 minimum score or confidence <0.80; later adjudication must bind the exact evidence. 09-B implements no adjudication or automatic promotion.
semantics.confidence: 0..1 self-reported evidence confidence, not probability of correctness or calibrated accuracy.
semantics.phaseBoundary: APPROVED records Product Owner approval of evaluation semantics on 2026-10-23. Fixture dispositions remain separate from content approval, provider/model budget, calibration acceptance, release gates and publication permission.

item.criterion: Tests the declared mental-unit decision in the owning node and respects prerequisites.
Every decisive claim is correct against attributable, relevant source evidence; declared URL alone is not fact checking.
All and only correct answers receive the intended score; key and instruction agree.
Decisive conditions are explicit and admit a defensible intended answer.
Reason/details and all applicable alternative explanations teach every mechanism/comparison needed, respect earlier prerequisites and require no later-node knowledge.
The learner can identify the requested action without guessing author intent.
B2-accessible prose uses precise domain terminology without diluting technical meaning.
Reasoning depth, difficulty and form fit Certification, Coding, or the particular Design Interview profile.
Exercises a useful decision, mechanism or diagnostic distinction, beyond cosmetic paraphrase.
Critical assertions bind specific adequate current source evidence and provenance.

unit.criterion: Questions exercise one recognizable mechanism/decision model.
Sibling units have distinct responsibilities within their frozen node.
The complete declared unit objective and node decision scope are covered by explicit item evidence.
Unit is neither an isolated fact nor a hidden mini-node.
The unit forms an explainable, practicable mental model at this prerequisite stage.
Every question has one best owning unit; no node redesign.

set.criterion: Every required decision has source-backed evidence mapped to all current item IDs; report gaps explicitly.
Similar questions teach distinct decisive conditions; lexical similarity alone is never a hard fail and paraphrase alone adds no coverage.
Contexts vary meaningfully rather than merely renaming entities.
Recall/application/diagnosis/trade-off/transfer and difficulty match the declared objective.
Answer positions, wording and recurring templates do not leak the key.
Source concentration is appropriate to the objective, with no invented breadth requirement.

choice_single.criterion: Exactly one best answer; plausible discriminating distractors; every alternative explained.

choice_multiple.criterion: Complete correct selection set, no omitted correct feedback, explicit cardinality/scoring.

ordering.criterion: Defensible precedence and any admissible ties agree with the actual scoring contract.

complexity.criterion: Time/space dimensions, assumptions and derivations are correct.

decision_matrix.criterion: Axes, valid combinations, trade-offs and per-cell scoring agree.

fcaBoundary: Mapping is traceability only. FCA outcomes are never imported as judge assessments. Coverage/remediation references the existing FCA registry/FCA-EDIT, without a second queue.

claudeMinimum.meaning: Separate count-only remediation to FCA-EDIT. No unit minimum, schema error or quality score; no compensating another node and no filler paraphrases.

exampleBoundary: All 09-B fixtures are proposed synthetic examples, NOT a human-accepted gold set.
